description:
'What will you fight for?' Get a deep dive into the world of Empulse in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person 6v6 arcade movement mech shooter developed by 1047 Games. Learn about the story setup, the different crews, and more. Empulse will be available in Early Access on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on June 24, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest.

In Empulse, wall-run, grapple, Holojump, pilot mechs, and P.A.I.N.T. your way through Freehold's vertical streets. Outmove your opponent or get outgunned.
title: Empulse - Official 'The World of Empulse' Trailer

description:
The finale to Legacy of the Sith is here. Watch the Star Wars: The Old Republic 'Legacy Reborn' launch trailer for this Game Update 7.9 for the MMORPG. Darth Jadus has stolen the key to Darth Nul’s masterworks, and the race to the forgotten fortress of Naga Sadow on Khar Shian has begun. In the Legacy Reborn update, the battle transcends your own perspective. For the first time, take control of your allies in unique gameplay to reach the final showdown. With Malgus, Shae Vizla, and the Hidden Chain converging on the Sith moon, the outcome will determine the fate of the galaxy!

Game Update 7.9 'Legacy Reborn' is available now in Star Wars: The Old Republic.
title: Star Wars: The Old Republic - Official Legacy Reborn Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston, a new three-part docudrama distributed by National Geographic. Hear the final hours before the eruption of Mount Vesuvius from previously unaccounted-for perspectives in Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston, streaming on July 23 on Disney+ and Hulu, alongside premiering on National Geographic on July 22.

Host and “Loki” star Tom Hiddleston and “Loki” executive producer Kevin R. Wright reunite for Pompeii: Out of Time, a fusion of cinematic scripted drama and investigative documentary storytelling that transports audiences to ancient Rome in the hours before and during the eruption of Mount Vesuvius. Guided by a team of archaeologists, historians, geologists and disaster experts, he uncovers remarkable evidence — and the stories of real people that challenge long-held assumptions about Pompeii and its final hours — not least revealing that many of those caught up in the disaster had the chance to sur
title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston - Official Trailer (2026)

author: IGN
description:
Check out the teaser trailer for Disney's Hexed, an upcoming animated magical coming-of-age adventure film. Hexed features the voice talents of Hailee Steinfeld as Billie, Rashida Jones as Billie's mother Alice, Tracey Ullman as the enchanted feather quill pen Ms. Quill, and Stephen Fry as the magical journal Elias Quire.

In Hexed, an awkward teen and her Type-A mother learn her peculiarities might be magical powers, transforming their lives and revealing a hidden magical realm.

Disney’s Hexed is directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad, and produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino. Hexed opens in theaters on November 25, 2026.

#IGN
title: Hexed - Official Teaser Trailer (2026) Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones

author: IGN
description:
Stranger Than Heaven is the next game from RGG Studio, makers of the Yakuza / Like A Dragon series, and this time it's taking you through Japan's past across five different decades in five different cities to tell the story of Makoto Daito and the origins of the infamous Tojo Clan. It uses action combat, but nothing like it was in the Yakuza games, because it has a much more in-depth slower-paced fighting system that looks to be challenging. We got to play a brief demo at Summer Game Fest, and these are our thoughts right from the show itself. Stranger Than Heaven launches on January 15, 2027 for PlayStation, Xbox, and PC.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Stranger Than Heaven Hands-On Impressions: Yakuza, Like A Souls Game

author: IGN
description:
Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the toys are back for Toy Story 5, and this time they're facing the toughest threat yet... screen time! While it's been a flagship franchise for animation pioneer Pixar, they've managed to write two separate satisfying endings for the sentient toys. So why do they keep coming back? Clint Gage reviews the fifth installment of the series to talk about that, plus series newcomers like Lillypad (Greta Lee) and Smarty Pants (Conan O'Brien) why some legacy characters getting sidelined is exactly what Toy Story needs, and the conversations he had with his kids after the screening!

#ToyStory5 #Movies #IGN
title: Toy Story 5 Review

author: IGN
description:
Check out the teaser trailer for Shrek 5, an upcoming magical comedy adventure animated film from DreamWorks Animation. Shrek 5 stars Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy, and Cameron Diaz as they return to their signature roles as Shrek, Donkey and Fiona. Zendaya joins the cast as Shrek and Fiona’s daughter Felicia, along with Marcello Hernandez and Skyler Gisondo as Felicia’s brothers, Fergus and Farkle. Shrek 5 opens in theaters in summer 2027.

Shrek 5 is directed by acclaimed filmmakers and Shrek franchise veterans Conrad Vernon and Walt Dohrn. Vernon was a member of the directing team on the Academy Award nominated Shrek 2 as well as on DreamWorks Animation’s Madagascar 3: Europe’s Most Wanted and Monsters vs. Aliens. Vernon has also provided the voice of Shrek fan-favorite Gingerbread Man, aka “Gingy,” across all titles in the Shrek Universe. Dohrn worked on the second and third Shrek films as a writer and artist and as Head of Story on the fourth film. Dohrn also voiced the character of R
title: Shrek 5 - Official Teaser Trailer (2027) Mike Myers, Zendaya, Eddie Murphy, Cameron Diaz

author: IGN
description:
Here's your look at the Let My Family In announcement trailer for this upcoming bunker gatekeeper simulator game set amid an impending nuclear collapse. Let My Family In will be available on PC. A Kickstarter campaign will be available beginning July 2, 2026.

In Let My Family In, the world above is collapsing, and every person who reaches the bunker arrives with the same plea: let them and their family inside. As the Overseer, the player must decide who is admitted and who is turned away, knowing that every decision may affect not only immediate survival, but the long-term future of the colony itself.
title: Let My Family In - Official Announcement Trailer

The Black Tides Quest is available now with the final Title Update for Assassin's Creed Shadows, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.

description:
Watch the latest ARC Raiders trailer to see what to expect with the Forgotten Relics event for the third-person action extraction shooter game, featuring a new player project, Converging Paths, and the ability to earn the Stalkwalker outfit. The Forgotten Relics event runs from June 16 through July 27, 2026.

Head Topside to gather supplies and forgotten relics for the nomads, and secure safe passage for travelers on dangerous routes - if you can learn to trust each other, perhaps they’ll share what they know. Take part in the Forgotten Relics event to earn the Saltwalker outfit, and work towards a new project, Converging Paths.

#ARCRaiders #ForgottenRelicsEvent #Gaming

author: IGN
description:
Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival gets a brutal new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival Red Band Release Date trailer for this upcoming survival-horror action game. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on October 8, 2026. 

Embark on a battle for survival against Hell’s armies with a terrifying new story in the Hellraiser universe in Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival! Descend into the darkest depths of the underworld to rescue your love from the depraved clutches of the Cenobites. Face your deepest fears against deviant wretches, cultists and creatures with the infernal powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box and an arsenal of earthly weapons.

#CliveBarkersHellraiserRevival #Gaming #IGN
title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Official Red Band Release Date Trailer

Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion launch trailer for this game-expanding narrative inspired by the dramatic events of Jurassic World Rebirth. 

In the Jurassic World Evolution 3 expansion, push the boundaries of science and develop the top-secret facility on Île Saint-Hubert! Use new technology to manage formidable predators, harness the power of Geothermal energy, and come face-to-face with four new dinosaurs, including the terrifying Distortus rex.

#JurassicWorldEvolution3 #Gaming #IGN

author: IGN
description: Blood Message has drawn comparisons to both God of War and The Last of Us. That's rarified company and, while it’s still too early to say it belongs in that echelon, it definitely borrows elements from both, and from what we’ve seen, does so exceptionally well. But it also has a clear identity of its own, with a setting grounded in real history and drama, and action that feels like every blow counts.
title: Blood Message Is Visually Stunning, Seemingly With the Gameplay to Back it Up | IGN Preview

description: Get a closer look at Zlin City: Arch Moderna in this latest trailer for the upcoming strategy city builder game. Build charming miniature diorama cities and train routes in a magical world inspired by the 1920s–30s in Zlin City: Arch Moderna. Create cozy towns, craft detailed rail networks, and relax to an original soundtrack. Inspired by real historical events and the architecture of Zlin.
